Name: Aba's Tilly and Riley Compat
Author: Abagaianye
Description:
[b][u][size=5]About The Mod[/size][/u][/b]
Strawhatwem's NPC [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38008]Tilly[/url] and EssGee's NPC [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36094]Riley[/url] (updated for 1.6 by awillowwisp) both want to put their houses in the same garden area above the blacksmith. Disaster!

This mod lets them coexist peacefully by moving Riley's house to the same location it shifts to in SVE.

[b][u][size=5]Installation[/size][/u][/b]
[i][u]Mod Manager ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop[/url]) - Vortex is not recommended[/u][/i]
[list]
[*]Click the "Mod manager download" button on the files page or the "Vortex" button at the top of any page.
[/list]
[i][u]Manual[/u][/i]
[list]
[*]Click the "Manual download" button to download the zip file.
[*]Open the zip file and drag the "[CP] Aba'sTillyRileyCompat" folder to your Mods folder.
[*]If you use the Windows right-click->"Extract All..." method to unzip, make sure you don't end up with nested mod folders.
[/list]

[b][u][size=5]Config[/size][/u][/b]
[i][u]Enable Mod[/u][/i]
[list]
[*]Disable to prevent this mod from doing anything.
[/list]
[i][u]Compatibility[/u][/i]
[list]
[*]Setting for map compatibility with other mods that edit the town map, such as East Scarp Remastered.
[*]Leave as "Automatic" to let the mod choose the right map patch to apply, or manually pick an option (vanilla or ESR) to override it.
[/list]

[u][b][size=5]Accessibility[/size][/b][/u]
[b][u]Vision[/u][/b]
[u][i]Stardew Access[/i][/u]
[list]
[*]This mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16205]Stardew Access[/url].
[/list]
[u][i]Trypophobia[/i][/u]
[list]
[*]This mod should be trypophobia safe.
[/list]
[b][u]Sound[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]There are no sounds added or edited by this mod.
[/list]
Please contact me if there are accessibility changes I can add for you.

[u][b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b][/u]
[list]
[*][b][color=red]IMPORTANT: This mod requires SMAPI version 4.4.0 or above! This means is it NOT compatible with mobile.[/color][/b]
[*]Automatically compatible with recolour mods and foliage retexture mods.
[*]Compatible with East Scarp Remastered.
[*]Not needed with Stardew Valley Expanded as Riley's house automatically moves to its alternate location when SVE is installed.
[/list]

[u][b][size=5]Multiplayer[/size][/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Works as intended in multiplayer.
[*]Ensure all players are using the same config settings to avoid bugs.
[/list]

[u][b][size=5]Uninstallation[/size][/b][/u]
[list]
[*]You can uninstall this mod at any time.
[*]Simply delete the mod folder.
[/list]

[u][b][size=5]Credits/Thanks[/size][/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Thanks to Wem for giving me permission to make and publish this mod.
[*]Thanks to EssGee for providing blanket permission on Riley's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5811]original mod page[/url] for compatibility mods such as this one to be published.
[/list]
